purpose: Read-only current-snapshot cleanup plan; no deletion or compression performed
scopeExclusions: All sibling regional-live-tests GUID directories; none inventoried or modified
Normal deployed native binaries/shaders and all production asset links outside the two named scratch roots
cleanupPreconditions: Lead declares relevant investigations resolved and final validation/evidence complete
No live process uses either scratch root; never delete while GPU tests or private-host checks continue
Verify absolute paths remain within the two exact roots, links/reparse state and manifest identities before removal
Delete only proven disposable scratch links/files; never follow a hard link to its protected name
Keep current source, normal deployment, assets, cache and earlier evidence untouched

cleanupClassification.responsibility: Overwritten transient GPU readbacks consumed by retained parity tooling
cleanupClassification.disposition: REMOVE after final numerical/hash parity summaries and reproduction scripts are retained; no bulk raw retention

cleanupClassification.group: host, layers, standalone fragment/material prototype copies
cleanupClassification.responsibility: Private diagnostic deployment and scoped Vulkan layer manifests
cleanupClassification.disposition: REMOVE after tests; regenerate with retained whole.py, patches and source. Elevation path is scratch hardlink only.
REMOVE only after lead retains exact failure/classification/reproduction evidence in final package; no classification inferred here

cleanupClassification.responsibility: Generated live-regression frame snapshots; contain generation, camera, pupil and regional sample fields
cleanupClassification.disposition: REMOVE after completed test failure classification/summary is retained; preserve permanent test source and other active GUIDs

accountingLimits: Snapshot may change while lead tests continue; refresh at final cleanup.
Logical bytes count directory entries; hardlinked source asset bytes are not disk recovery.
Allocated file payload measured with FileStandardInfo.AllocationSize; excludes filesystem directory/MFT metadata.
Exclusive recoverable allocation requires all names of a file inside the cleanup roots.
Current sizes cannot establish cumulative write I/O because captures/logs can overwrite the same names.
Evidence snapshot excludes the storage plan and notes created afterward.
Evidence files changed during allocation recheck are explicitly listed; its logical inventory and allocation recheck are not claimed to be one atomic snapshot. Refresh at closeout.

compressionPolicy.scope: Only new evidence .json files larger than threshold; retain journal bytes losslessly as .json.gz
required: Verify decompression SHA-256 equals original before removing plain journal
Update retained readers/report references to support .json.gz before plain-file removal
Do not modify previous evidence packages

allocationMeasurement: GetFileInformationByHandleEx(FileStandardInfo=1).AllocationSize using read-attributes handle with read/write/delete sharing. GetCompressedFileSize is not used as allocation proof.
gitClassificationMethod: git check-ignore -z --stdin and git ls-files -z with byte-mode NUL records; avoids Windows text-mode CRLF path corruption.
